sources.title: July 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: July 2026 management information is a 16 July snapshot and was updated on 20 July 2026.
Contracted premises cover initial scope and may exclude deferred scope.
Management figures are not directly comparable with official subsidy-attributable delivery statistics.
Figures are rounded to the nearest 10 and should not be used to assess contractual milestones.
The July table reports 838,490 contracted premises and 287,510 built contracted premises.

sources.title: June 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: June 2026 management information is a 17 June snapshot and was updated on 20 July 2026.
The June release reports 839,340 contracted premises and 271,460 built contracted premises.
A variable lag exists between contract delivery and BDUK data ingestion.
North Dorset had 310 premises removed with an intention to re-add them later.
Rounded management data must preserve source month and administrative revision context.

sources.title: October 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: The October 2025 release was updated on 20 July 2026 and represents a 21 October snapshot.
The table reports 1,002,270 contracted premises and 150,730 built contracted premises.
Initial scope and deferred scope must remain distinct.
Figures are rounded to the nearest 10.
Historic monthly snapshots are not audited measures of contractual milestone performance.

sources.title: November 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: The November 2025 release was updated on 20 July 2026 and represents a 17 November snapshot.
The table reports 1,002,210 contracted premises and 167,770 built contracted premises.
Monthly contracted and built totals are management information rather than official statistics.
Delivery-to-ingestion lag prevents direct milestone assessment.
Contract-area totals cannot establish service at every UPRN.

sources.title: December 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: The December 2025 release was updated on 20 July 2026 and represents a 17 December snapshot.
The table reports 1,002,400 contracted premises and 183,380 built contracted premises.
The Fibrus Northern Irish contract was excluded because of ingestion lag.
Exclusion from a monthly edition is not evidence of zero delivery or no service.
Rounded totals and scope changes require tolerance and provenance preservation.

sources.title: Building Digital UK performance information
facts: BDUK separates official delivery statistics, monthly contract reports and annual reports.
Quarterly official statistics contain a subset of the full annual tables.
Monthly contract reports are not directly comparable with official subsidy-attributable delivery statistics.
The collection links to OMR determinations and premises in BDUK plans as a separate evidence family.
Evidence type must be preserved before cross-publication comparison.

sources.title: 4G coverage local indicator
facts: The indicator measures outdoor geographic 4G coverage from at least one operator using a -105 dBm threshold.
The data vintage is January 2026 and the publication date is 13 May 2026.
The displayed geography is lower-tier or unitary authority area.
Confidence intervals are not available.
ONS warns that aggregation may produce differences from other published figures.

sources.title: 5G coverage local indicator
facts: The indicator measures outdoor geographic 5G coverage from at least one operator using a -110 dBm threshold.
The data vintage is January 2026 and the publication date is 13 May 2026.
The displayed geography is lower-tier or unitary authority area.
Confidence intervals are not available.
Geographic area coverage is not premises, indoor or address-level coverage.
